name: Boarding Plank
body:
School evocation [force]; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range see text
Area see text
Duration 5 minutes/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell creates a shimmering board of force, 4 feet in width and stretching up to 25 feet long. The board keeps itself level at all times and can support a weight of up to a ton and a half (3,000 pounds) before it collapses.

Casting this spell requires you to touch either the ship or where it is to dock and mentally extend the board to its destination.
